title: Mumbo Cutout
description: This adds your very own Mumbo Cutout to have in your world!
body:
You can now have your VERY OWN MumboJumbo Cardboard Cutout to add to your VANILLA Minecraft world! That's right, NO MODS needed!

Simply rename a piece of redstone dust to "Mumbo" in an anvil and BAM! You have your own Mumbo friend, similar to the one seen in the 2026 Gamers Outreach Hermitcraft Weekend!

You can also use the Item Model Applier Datapack to apply the model to ANY item, by renaming it "mumbo:cutout", and applying the model with the datapack!

Alternatively, you can have a Mumbo that looks like the same cutout that you saw in the charity livestream by naming redstone "Cursed Mumbo", or any item "mumbo:cursed_cutout"!

You can also now have the Mumbo Armour Stand variant as seen in Mumbo's latest episode (prior to moving to France)! Simply rename redstone to "Mumbo Stand", or any item to "mumbo:stand"!

You can make him placable by popping your Mumbo into an item frame, invisible item frames work best!

I may add more Hermit Cutouts in the future, or other Hermitcraft related items! Feel free to suggest some!
